methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab targets workplace professionals outside traditional tech hubs, creating peer-to-peer learning infrastructure that could distribute deep AI capability beyond NoVA if it achieves sustainable scale and community adoption.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native represent grassroots capability-building in a military-adjacent region, testing whether local champions can bootstrap distributed AI fluency without relying on platform vendors or metro spillover.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates institutional AI capacity in the state capital, but success depends on whether university-community bridges enable broad workforce penetration or remain confined to academic and professional networks.

signals.title: Left hand, right hand: Virginia cools on data centers even as state policy promotes the AI that requires them - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's policy incoherence—promoting AI while localities reject the data center infrastructure it requires—signals a failure to align state vision with community implementation, risking both shallow adoption and geographic fragmentation.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - axios.com
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests platform-delivered tools are creating surface-level adoption demands without corresponding depth in AI literacy or critical evaluation skills, pointing toward shallow but spreading capability.
